challenge.better_approach: Restoring the instance-dir short-circuit was looked at; ticket 8c5fdb750b75 removed it on purpose (the shim keeps last_known under the answers_as name, so a stray instance dir would seal the alias). One grep keeps that rule and drops the forks.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That grep -l lists files in argument order, so the first hit is the glob-order first match the loop took; GNU grep does, and the charters declare each answers_as once.
challenge.prior_art: cairn/tools/rack folder_of reads the same answers_as field in Python; bin/cairn is bash on the hot path and cannot import it without a python start (~30 ms), so one grep is the cheap mirror.
challenge.real_collision: none: 8c5fdb750b75 keeps its rule; only the cost changes.

answers.falsifier: Done when test_happy_path_costs_under_10ms reads under 10 ms on main with the fix, red without it, and test_a_declared_name_outranks_a_stray_instance_dir.py stays green. Wrong intent if the cost is contention (a re-run alone turns green) rather than the forks.
answers.from_idea: none, because it was measured on ticket 8c5fdb750b75 in bin/cairn (commit 7ada27cdb dropped the instance-dir short-circuit)
answers.how: Replace bin/cairn's per-charter grep loop with one grep -lE over cairn/devices/*/intention+why.json, guarded with || true under set -euo pipefail, taking the first match in glob order. The existing tooth test_happy_path_costs_under_10ms in bin/proofs/test_cairn_floor.py is the proof; its PROVES gains this ticket's key.
answers.traces_to: Law 8 (nothing enters proven-space without a proof a hollow build could not pass): test_cairn_floor reads red on main, so the floor's sealed claim no longer holds; Law 9: a red is fixed or carries a decision.
answers.what: bin/cairn looks up a declared answers_as name with one grep over the device charters, so a device that lives only in instance space costs the dispatcher under the floor's 10 ms budget again.

bullets.text: Measured 2026-11-18: test_cairn_floor happy path +17.6 to +21.6 ms at HEAD, +3.1 and +3.6 ms at 7ada27cdb's parent; 7ada27cdb dropped the instance-dir short-circuit, so 16 forked greps run per instance-only device.
Under set -euo pipefail a no-match grep in a command substitution ends bin/cairn silently; the one-grep form needs || true (the first draft made cairn test exit with no output).
